title.zh: 韩国股市遭遇「双熔断」，美中期选举余波持续冲击全球市场
title.en: 韩国股市遭遇「双熔断」，美中期选举余波持续冲击全球市场

current_state.zh: Korean equities suffered twin circuit breakers as KOSPI fell 5.5% and KOSDAQ 5.11%, with Samsung, SK Hynix and power-equipment makers sliding sharply on fears that US midterm election results will bring stricter AI data-center and electricity-cost regulation, pressuring hyperscaler capex and memory-chip demand.
